method: Surface records were confirmed from files listed in the row 018 FULL_READ_MANIFEST. The generated all-surface structural inventory was used only for navigation.
limitation_statement: This file is a surface-specific active-code Atlas slice, not acceptance of the generated all-surface active-code Atlas as semantic truth.
surface_limitation: This pass adjudicates transform-boundary proof for selected native raw-signal carrier, trace, coverage, and dataset-packet files. It does not adjudicate all raw signal providers, raw signal preparation, live market-data adapters, cognition, risk, capital authority, or runtime trading behaviour.

records.title: Native raw-signal files exclude donor schema/preparation/runtime owners
adjudication_notes: The new Tier A family parses selected native raw-signal files and rejects donor/raw-preparation/runtime owner imports.
The same family rejects recreation of donor schema/preparation symbols such as RawSignalSchema, RawSignalPreparationService, SignalPreparationRuntime, and option-surface donor names.
Targeted proof passed without source repair; the transform-required donor cluster was represented as a boundary guard, not imported as native runtime behaviour.
non_claims: Does not prove all raw signal providers or live market-data preparation semantics.
Does not upgrade the whole 5.3 surface to implemented.
Does not authorise donor compatibility wrappers, cognition, broker, capital, risk-policy, dependency, or runtime trading behaviour.
